quotes.text:
The contents of this directory are from the MAPI Stub Library, formerly
Outlook MAPI Headers.

The files were downloaded from https://github.com/microsoft/MAPIStubLibrary
at revision a888542d2e2630bf0da3b3855d198773b61c700e.

Changes:

- The files have been renamed to lower-cased filenames for cross-compiling
compatibility.
- MAPI.h was intentionally removed.
- MAPIx.h has had its #include lines changed to use double quotes rather than
  angled brackets

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 564 updates the bulk MAPIStubLibrary headers and records the exact upstream Microsoft revision. Its README separately documents lowercase filenames for cross-compiling, the intentionally removed MAPI.h and quoted includes in MAPIx.h. That lowercase rule is an imported-SDK compatibility constraint, not a naming rule for every Thunderbird C++ file. The upstream bodies were not fully read; README and selected ARM ABI changes were inspected. Do not use the SDK uppercase macro style or tabs to define Thunderbird-owned style.
title: Keep imported SDK provenance and deliberate compatibility edits explicit
